# Inks & Interfaces

> Inks & Interfaces is a founder-led branding studio offering brand strategy, logo design, visual identity, rebranding, brand naming, brand websites and pitch decks. Two founders, Shivani Rotliwala (brand strategy and visual design) and Sakhi Rotliwala (interactive design and engineering), do all the work themselves. Based in India, working with founders in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, Singapore and the UAE.

- Projects are fixed-fee, quoted in USD or INR after a 20-minute call.
- Identity and rebrand projects usually take 4 to 6 weeks; a website adds about 4 weeks.
- Work runs asynchronously across time zones with a weekly live check-in.
- Contact: studio@inksandinterfaces.design or https://inksandinterfaces.design/contact

## Pages

- [Services](https://inksandinterfaces.design/services): brand strategy and positioning, naming and verbal identity, logo and visual identity systems, rebranding, websites, product UI/UX, launch content and investor decks
- [Work](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work): 31 brand identity case studies
- [Studio](https://inksandinterfaces.design/studio): the founders and how the studio works
- [Contact](https://inksandinterfaces.design/contact): start a project, FAQ

## Case studies

- [Azonix](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/azonix): Ireland. Logo, iOS app icon set, Animated splash screen, App loader animation. A fitness app that adapts to you, with a mark that moves like it.
- [Yellow Pod](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/yellow-pod): Surat, IN. Naming strategy, Logo system, Mascot and illustrations, Menu design, Thank-you and care card, Brand guidelines. Real cocoa, real vanilla, and a name parents can say.
- [Tritaksh](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/tritaksh): India. Brand strategy, Devanagari calligraphic wordmark, Motif and pattern, Brand guidelines, Instagram launch content. Every masterpiece begins long before the first stitch.
- [Mickey Minnie Playschool](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/mickey-minnie-playschool): Noida, IN. Logo system, Brand guidelines, Visual system, Print assets. A playful rebrand for a beloved playschool.
- [Zestee](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/zestee): Mumbai, IN. Logo system, Café packaging, Menu architecture, Print + social system, Sign-writing program. From juice bar to destination café.
- [Vanya Luxe](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/vanya-luxe): Paris, France. E-commerce UX, Packaging Design, Art Direction, Digital Strategy. Vanya Luxe.
- [PIQ](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/piq): Los Angeles, US. Wordmark, Can system, Glass bottle, Squeeze bottle, Trade dress. Caffeine, lemonade, and an exclamation mark.
- [The Ube Press](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/the-ube-press): Manila / Brooklyn. Brand identity, Menu design, Interior wayfinding, Storefront signage. A modern café rooted in heritage.
- [GlobeTap](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/globetap): Bengaluru / Berlin. Product strategy, User flows, UI system, Component library, Motion spec. A travel booking habit, mapped to your day.
- [Terra Cork](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/terra-cork): Melbourne, AU. Wordmark, Product packaging suite, Trade dress, Photography direction, Brand book. Cork, finally treated like a material instead of a fix.
- [Ciao](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/ciao): Bopal, Ahmedabad. Wordmark, Menu design, Storefront signage, Print collateral, Brand voice. Wood-fired Naples, on a side street in Bopal.
- [Go Miles](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/go-miles): London, UK. Logo Design, Fleet Graphics, Driver Apparel, Digital Assets. Go Miles.
- [Oakmere](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/oakmere): Portland, Oregon. Brand Identity, E-Commerce Website, Bottle Labels, Packaging. Oakmere.
- [Matcha Den](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/matcha-den): Bengaluru, IN. Logo system, Packaging suite, Outdoor signage, Sticker sheet, Brand guidelines. A modern den for an ancient ritual.
- [The Saucy Heat](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/the-saucy-heat): Singapore. Wordmark, Label system, Tube format, Trade dress, Brand guidelines. A chilli oil that prefers a long, slow burn.
- [Lab Coat Media](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/lab-coat-media): USA. Wordmark, Visual system, Accessible website, Component library, Brand guidelines. A media brand built to be readable by everyone.
- [Waggle](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/waggle): Bengaluru, IN. Wordmark, Food + treat packaging, Accessories (toy, bowl, bandana, harness), Illustrated mascot, Brand book. A pet brand designed for the human who actually buys it.
- [Misomaki](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/misomaki): Tokyo & New York. Logo System, Takeaway Packaging, Menu Design, Brand Guidelines. Misomaki.
- [Hardin Jewels](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/hardin-jewels): Surat, Gujarat, India. Logo System, Packaging Design, Lookbook, Campaign Art Direction. Hardin Jewels.
- [Evoque](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/evoque): Los Angeles, CA. Visual Identity, Bottle Design, Packaging, Social Strategy. Evoque.
- [Trivid Yoga](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/trivid-yoga): Surat, IN. Wordmark, Mat + tote system, Class collateral, Online tutorial brand, Studio signage. Twenty years of teaching, finally given a name.
- [Paperboat](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/paperboat): Self-initiated concept. Wordmark refresh, Pack system, Illustration system update, Range architecture, Concept brand book. A nostalgic Indian icon, rebuilt for its next decade.
- [Woven Wax](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/woven-wax): Brooklyn, NY. Label System, Box Design, Brand Identity, Photography. Woven Wax.
- [Golden Crust](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/golden-crust): Lisbon, PT. Wordmark, Bread + pastry packaging, Stickers + tape, Storefront mockup, Photography direction. A neighbourhood bakery, treated like an heirloom.
- [Royal Eats](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/royal-eats): Hyderabad, IN. Brand identity, Packaging design, Visual system. A modern identity for a beloved snack brand.
- [Plush Paws](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/plush-paws): Dubai, UAE. Wordmark, Food can + pouch, Treat box system, Accessory range, Trade dress. Pet food, finally treated like premium FMCG.
- [Pure Sip](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/pure-sip): Austin, TX. Logo System, Can Design, Carton Packaging, 3D Renders. Pure Sip.
- [Rich Kanya](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/rich-kanya): Mumbai, India. Logo System, Typography, Billboard Graphics, Brand Guidelines. Rich Kanya.
- [Kitkat Protein Bar](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/kitkat-protein-bar): Self-initiated concept. Wordmark adaptation, Wrapper system, Multipack, Macro callouts, Trade window display. A childhood favourite, rebuilt for the gym.
- [Satori Bites](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/satori-bites): San Francisco, CA. Packaging System, Illustration, Brand Identity. Satori Bites.
- [Silver Sphere Tech](https://inksandinterfaces.design/work/silver-sphere-tech): USA. Wordmark + monogram, Signage system, Trade dress, Print collateral, Brand guidelines. IT services with an AI layer — finally branded like it.
